intro.title: Framing Services
intro.mainText: Good framing is the foundation of a clean, durable and well-built interior. VV Renovation provides precise framing work for partitions, ceilings, renovation layouts and finish carpentry with attention to structure, alignment and long-term reliability.
intro.secondaryText: We work with homeowners, designers and builders across the Greater Vancouver Area to deliver clean, reliable and professional framing services.

items.question: What types of framing do you offer?
items.answer: We provide wood framing, steel stud framing and custom structural framing for residential and commercial projects across the Greater Vancouver Area.

items.question: Do you handle both small and large projects?
items.answer: Yes, we work on everything from small renovations and basement framing to full-scale residential builds and commercial spaces.

items.question: How long does framing usually take?
items.answer: The timeline depends on the size and complexity of the project. Most residential framing jobs are completed within a few days to a couple of weeks.

items.question: Do you follow building codes and regulations?
items.answer: Yes, all framing work is completed according to local building codes and industry standards to ensure safety, accuracy and durability.

items.question: Do you work across the Greater Vancouver Area?
items.answer: Yes, we provide flooring installation services across Vancouver and surrounding areas including Burnaby, Richmond, Surrey, New Westminster, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Port Moody, Maple Ridge, Pitt Meadows, White Rock, North Vancouver (City), North Vancouver (District), West Vancouver, Delta, Langley (City), Langley (Township).
